warfarin.frequency: Every 2-3 days during initiation, then weekly until stable, then monthly
warfarin.rationale: Ensure anticoagulation is within therapeutic range and detect bleeding risk early.

metformin.frequency: Baseline and at least annually (every 3-6 months if reduced renal function)
metformin.rationale: Metformin is contraindicated in significant renal impairment due to lactic acidosis risk.

methotrexate.frequency: Baseline, every 2-4 weeks for 3 months, then every 8-12 weeks
methotrexate.guideline_source: Methotrexate Therapy for Rheumatoid Arthritis Guideline

methotrexate.frequency: Baseline, every 2-4 weeks for 3 months, then every 8-12 weeks
methotrexate.guideline_source: Methotrexate Therapy for Rheumatoid Arthritis Guideline

simvastatin.rationale: Establish baseline liver function before starting statin therapy.
simvastatin.guideline_source: Statin Therapy for Lipid Management Guideline

furosemide.frequency: Baseline, 1-2 weeks after initiation/dose change, then periodically
furosemide.rationale: Detect hypokalemia, hyponatremia, and renal impairment early.
furosemide.guideline_source: Diuretic Management in Heart Failure Guideline

lisinopril.frequency: Baseline, 1-2 weeks after initiation, and at every dose titration
lisinopril.rationale: Detect hyperkalemia and acute kidney injury risk from ACE inhibition.

digoxin.test: Serum Digoxin Level, Potassium & Renal Function
digoxin.frequency: Baseline, 1-2 weeks after initiation/dose change, then periodically
digoxin.rationale: Narrow therapeutic index; detect toxicity risk and renal-clearance changes early.

levothyroxine.frequency: Baseline, every 6-8 weeks until stable, then annually
levothyroxine.rationale: Confirm dose is achieving euthyroid state without over- or under-replacement.

clopidogrel.frequency: Periodically during prolonged dual antiplatelet therapy

insulin.frequency: Before meals and at bedtime during initiation/titration
insulin.rationale: Titrate dose safely and detect hypoglycemia early.

losartan.frequency: Baseline and within 1-2 weeks of initiation or dose titration
losartan.rationale: Detect hyperkalemia and renal function changes from ARB therapy.

prednisone.rationale: Corticosteroids can induce hyperglycemia and hypertension.
